caption: The drawing depicts a small, light gray ceramic or painted figurine in the shape of a rabbit sitting upright on a rectangular base. The rabbit has its head slightly tilted upwards and to the left, with both ears visible—one ear is more pronounced. Red coloring is used for the inside of the visible ear, as well as for markings above the rabbit’s eye and on its nose. The eye, nose, and mouth are outlined in black, and there is further black detailing for the toes on the rabbit’s front paw. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color with some minor spotting. The artist’s name, "ANDREW T. POLOSKEY," is faintly written in pencil near the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Seated Chalkware Rabbit
